text:
Samira Patel: quick follow-up on the postmortem action list from last night — several items are still listed as OPEN in the doc. please update ownership + ETA by EOD or we'll need to escalate. link: https://redwood.internal/postmortems/pm-2026-03-kv-thundering-herd

Samira Patel: current snapshot (copied from doc):
1) add adaptive backoff to job dispatcher - owner: Jordan - due 2026-03-20 - OPEN
2) reserve dedicated node for KV cache (billing approval) - owner: Tao - due 2026-03-22 - OPEN
3) add alerting for queue saturation - owner: Maria - due 2026-03-19 - OPEN
4) rollout canary config for lower p95 - owner: Jordan - due 2026-03-21 - OPEN

Jordan Lee: saw this. working on #1 and #4 but need one more day. backoff change requires a small refactor + a test harness. ETA new: 2026-03-25.

Tao Nguyen: billing ping still pending from finance for the extra node. I filed FIN-4872 last week, no response yet. if we can't get approval we may need to implement a cheaper multi-tenant fallback. ETA depends on finance, but I'll keep pushing.

Maria Chen: alerting item: I prototyped a saturation rule but it needs threshold tuning to avoid noise. can land the alert in staging by 2026-03-24. FYI this is the 3rd incident where queue saturation preceded KV timeouts — we should consider a repeat-pattern remediation.

Samira Patel: @Hugo can you help unblock FIN-4872? Tao's blocked on purchase approval and that item is delaying an infra mitigation.

Hugo Alvarez: on it. I'll escalate to finance and copy legal (for cost center). Tao, expect a reply by 2026-03-23 17:00 UTC. If finance stalls, I'll temporarily approve a $X spend for the node.

Jordan Lee: noted. I'll reprioritize the backoff refactor to land earlier if the node is delayed. will push a WIP PR today.

Samira Patel: reminder: when you update the doc, include the acceptance criteria (how we'll verify fix in production) — otherwise postmortem remains open. example: `PR merged + canary < 2% errors for 48h`.

reminder-bot: automated reminder: 3 OPEN action items in postmortem pm-2026-03-kv-thundering-herd. Next reminder in 48h. :bell:

Tao Nguyen: finance replied — need a clarification on usage pattern. I sent sample tail logs and cost estimate. expecting final signoff tomorrow morning.

Maria Chen: adding note — recommend a recurring 30-day runbook review for queue thresholds. If we do that, it should prevent the recurring pattern.

Hugo Alvarez: thanks. please set owner + add a JIRA for the recurring review (owner: Maria, due 2026-04-07). I'll accept the temporary spend if finance delays.

Jordan Lee: pushed WIP PR: https://git.internal/redwood/repo/pulls/9123 — includes backoff + unit tests. still needs a couple of perf runs.

Samira Patel: great. Jordan, mark #1 as "IN PROGRESS" in the doc and paste that PR link. Tao, update #2 when finance signs off. Maria, create the JIRA for the recurring review and paste the ticket here.

Jordan Lee: done — updated doc and changed status. PR link above.

Tao Nguyen: finance approved. node provisioning in progress. updated doc to DONE when instance is healthy and canary passes.

Maria Chen: created JIRA INC-7254 for recurring runbook review: https://jira.internal/browse/INC-7254 — owner: Maria, due 2026-04-07. added checklist.

Samira Patel: final check — once PR merges and the node canary is green, post the verification (PR + canary window screenshot or logs) and I'll close the postmortem action item list. trying to avoid another round of chase. :pray:

Hugo Alvarez: noted. I'll spot-check closure evidence before Samira closes items.

Jordan Lee: PR merged and canary perf looks good: p95 down 18%. posting canary logs to the doc.

reminder-bot: automated: thread status change detected — 1 OPEN action item remaining.

Tao Nguyen: node is live and canary passed. updated doc with deploy id and logs: deploy-2026-03-24-07:22. Marking #2 DONE.

Samira Patel: verified PR + canary logs. closing items now. thanks everyone for the follow-ups. we'll track the recurring-review in INC-7254 and report back after the first checkpoint. :white_check_mark:
